pack_numpy_array_to_tensor_proto: pack a numpy array or scalar into a dm_env_rpc Tensor protobuf message
unpack_tensor_proto_to_numpy_array: unpack a dm_env_rpc Tensor protobuf message back into a numpy array or scalar
get_packer_for_numpy_dtype: get a Packer instance for a given numpy dtype to manually pack or unpack proto payloads
get_tensor_type_from_proto: get the numpy dtype corresponding to a dm_env_rpc Tensor protobuf message
convert_data_type_to_numpy_type: convert a dm_env_rpc DataType enum value to its corresponding numpy dtype
